Storybook story files are documentation/testing harnesses, not the active UI implementation that a point-and-edit change should anchor to.
Icon components are generated SVG wrappers with no meaningful UI composition; they are static visual assets, not edit targets for UI-originated changes.
Static image assets are not UI source anchors.
Data layer files (contexts, providers, services, hooks, types) do not participate in rendering the active UI surface and are not valid point-and-edit source anchors.
Build and tooling scripts (token extraction, icon generation, dev-resource management) are not UI source anchors.
Build output should never be selected as a source anchor.
Storybook configuration files are tooling, not UI source anchors.
